name: Zeno Hagan
original_name: ซีโน่ ฮาเกน
source:
Etymology: Zeno = Gift from God | Hagan = Protection
Age: 16
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: Grade 10 Student
Personality: Appears indifferent and lethargic, but possesses a brilliant analytical mind. Zeno dislikes chaos and avoids the spotlight, valuing logic and duty over emotion. Though he seems detached, he is constantly calculating; he will always choose the path that yields the maximum benefit.

[From in-game profile]
